product_metadata.title: PROLISOK Silicone Baking Mat Pack of 2 – Non-stick Reusable Baking Liners – Food Grade Safe Blue & Orange Oven Mats for Cookies, Macarons & Pastry – 2 Flexible Cooking Mats for Half Baking Sheets
features: Multipurpose Set: Prolisok Silicone Baking Mats are made for baking, roasting, and food preparation. Cook directly on the totally oven-safe mats, or place them under pies or casseroles, or use them in the refrigerator to chill your food masterpiece. No oil, spray, or butter is needed. Prolisok Baking Mats аre sized to fit all US standard half sheets (16.5 x 11.6").

Durable: Our Baking Mats are made from advanced flexible silicone and reinforced with fiberglass to cope with all of modern culinary techniques. Silicone Baking Mats can resist temperature from -40F up to 480F. The thickness of each mat is 0.03 inches.

Non-stick: Thanks to the special non-stick surface of the mat, the need for parchment paper, burned-on food residue, and tedious scrubbing are a thing of the past. Simply wash the mats by hand with soap and warm water and allow to air dry, or place in the dishwasher (top rack only).
Food Safe: Silicone Baking Mats are completely BPA free and have all of the necessary certificates of approval (FDA, LFGB).
Guaranteed Success: In case you are not completely satisfied with our Silicone Baking Liners, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee.
